posts.title: Multiple Ships, Liveries, and redoing it all again
posts.excerpt: Redoing the Starflier, Rhino and Defender, and multiple ships hangar!
posts.body:
# Never enough...

I have this issue that when I do something I demand absolute perfection from myself (and others (the AI lol)) and while it helps with details, it's not a healthy way to go about things :D

Either way, the closest to "perfect" I could've gotten was with Tripo AI modelling which turns images into wireframe models (textured) which I can then port 1:1 into the game.

Hence why now have the new Starflier:

![](images/uploads/2026-10-21-c02340c4-a134-4d0c-85c4-caec41025b44-mvi5j6v6.jpg)

New Rhino:

![](images/uploads/2026-10-21-image-mvi5jnqr.jpg)

And currently rebuilding the Defender:

![](images/uploads/2026-10-21-de60ae2b-6848-4444-a072-e3d82be5bfba-mvi5k7xy.jpg)

Ingame shots in the wiki soon.

Now I wanna redo the stations... man, it's not healthy :D

## Hangars, Multiple Ships and Liveries

Yes, you heard that right, multiple ships being owned will be possible. Well, it already is implemented :D Not a dream, it's already working.

With a storage where you can keep guns and cargo and whatnot.

I also wanna put more effort into the trading system of the game because I thought the original lacked this a bit.

What else happened:
* Liveries for each ship per player are possible and already work (eventually I wanna add an editor so you can make em yourself)
* Player storage MMO baseline for the servers works
* NPC combat is in
* Friendly NPCs
* Redid the Trade lane VFX
* Missiles, torpedos, shields, all added to the game (no visuals yet)
* Main menu with graphics settings etc
* Redid the badlands nebula (again)
* Lots of bugfixes

posts.title: 0.2.1 we have a working New York and Rhino ALL NEW!
posts.excerpt: New York fully designed (minus some stations), that was some work!
posts.body:
# We have a website! And what a shitshow :D

This is the first post here, hurray! But Im not going to go all teary eyed on it.
Simple, I have been working quite a while on this.
5 days to be precise :D

It's truly remarkable how insanely fast modern AI can do things.

From just an idea a week ago I already have New York fully running in UE, all in a few days.

But this is not to say there wasn't a complete bullshittery going on.

But I have noticed why.

## The prompt is everything

Initially I used Grokbot, which is already a big mistake because Claude Code is SO MUCH better. Light years away.

I still use Grokbot for my local PC stuff. Very good at that and nicely integrated. But for coding, Claude is truly unbeaten.

However, due to that initial prompt that basically just moved the entire OLD way of how New York was built into UE, I was stuck with 20 year old lighting, scripts, and stations.

I only noticed this once I wanted to add better lighting in the nebulas, and it was virtually impossible to get right.

After many thousands of AI tokens I literally told Claude "Do this thing, and forget everything in the project so far, old tech, redo it entirely from scratch with UE" and then it worked.

So I ran an audit on the code and it basically told me it all sucks :D

Thus, the last 3 days I was pretty much busy having it rewrite the entire system from scratch with new coding methods.

## Current Status

Enough bullshitting. We got it going. The Defender is (mostly) done, Rhino is entirely rebuilt (see Screenshot), bunch of stations are here and NPCs fly around.

Concept:

![](images/uploads/2026-10-18-d5156cc7-ddd2-4f27-954c-f856c1827a8a-mve2toxh.jpg)

Ingame:

![](images/uploads/2026-10-18-cargo0-00-hero-mve4kihn.jpg)

![](images/uploads/2026-10-18-cargo1-09-engines-mve4krcg.jpg)

![](images/uploads/2026-10-18-cargo0-08-police-mve4lk6v.jpg)



As you can tell it's not exactly the concept, but I actually like how it came out. Considering this took the AI about 20min to do :D

Also notice the new effect, when your cargo is above 60% it visibly carries cargo in the midsection.

Defender Concept:

![](images/uploads/2026-10-18-927e85be-d4ac-4231-8493-1b7d37a0e806-mve2veru.jpg)


Ingame:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VKFcgTnifbc

This video is already old tho, lots of stuff missing.

Nebulas look fire, mines work, and currently I am building the planet surface for Pittsburgh which will be another shitshow, but here we are :D

-Alex
